additional_sources.title: CEMEX UK: Cement Responsible Sourcing KPIs 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official CEMEX 2024 KPI table reports Rugby direct-plant, fossil-combustion, calcination, indirect and transport CO2 intensities plus alternative-fuel share. Values are per-tonne or percentage metrics, not annual facility tonnes and cannot be promoted to a parcel without a verified annual denominator.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency: Kimberly-Clark Northfleet Paper Mill permit application EPR/BJ7379IZ/V009
additional_sources.guard: Current Environment Agency notice identifies Northfleet Paper Mill, Crete Hall Road, Northfleet, DA11 9AD and permit EPR/BJ7379IZ/V009. Binding/identity evidence only; the application does not provide an observed annual GHG quantity.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency: VPI Immingham CHP Power Plant permit issued EPR/BJ8022IZ/V014
additional_sources.guard: Environment Agency decision confirms the issued varied and consolidated permit EPR/BJ8022IZ/V014 for Immingham CHP Power Plant. It upgrades application-stage binding to issued-permit binding but supplies no observed 2024 GHG quantity.

additional_sources.title: UK local and regional CO2 emissions tables 2005-2017: Pollution Inventory point-source table
additional_sources.guard: Public local-authority-hosted national statistics table contains operator, site, postcode, permit reference and 2005-2017 CO2 kt columns. Text extraction collapses blank year cells for some installations, so exact-year numeric promotion is withheld unless all year positions are unambiguous; no shifted-year inference is allowed.

additional_sources.title: Breedon Sustainability Data Basis of Reporting
additional_sources.guard: Official methodology states Scope 1 includes process and combustion emissions, process data includes cement works/brickworks, and UK/EU ETS kiln-fuel emissions data are used. Method provenance only; no facility value is invented.

additional_sources.title: VPI Immingham carbon capture project - Worley appointment
additional_sources.guard: Official VPI source states the Immingham project aims to capture up to 3.3 million tonnes CO2 per year. This is future capture capacity/abatement context, not observed current facility emissions.

additional_sources.title: Viridor Runcorn CCS environmental permit application
additional_sources.guard: Official Viridor source states planned Runcorn CCS would capture almost one million tonnes CO2 per annum. Planned capture is abatement capacity, not observed facility emissions.

additional_sources.title: Uniper Grain Carbon Capture design study
additional_sources.guard: Official Uniper source states Grain Carbon Capture has potential to remove over 2 million tonnes CO2 per year. Potential future removal is not observed current facility emissions.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CONTEXT: Intensity, percentage or product/resource metrics remain context and cannot become annual facility emissions without a verified denominator and compatible scope.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit/address/facility evidence strengthens identity/binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Exact year, facility, gas, quantity and unit must be unambiguously aligned before numeric promotion. Blank-cell collapse or column shift blocks promotion.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Methodology/provenance sources do not create measured values by themselves.
guard_contract.ABATEMENT_CONTEXT: Planned capture, avoided emissions or future removal capacity is not observed emissions and cannot be substituted for facility totals.

web_research_basis: Fresh public internet research on 2026-07-27 using Environment Agency/GOV.UK, CEMEX UK, Breedon, VPI, Viridor, Uniper and public government-statistics table surfaces. Historical Pollution Inventory rows for Northfleet, Rugby and Drax were inspected but exact-year mapping was withheld where blank cells collapse in machine text. PDF screenshot was attempted for the historical table and cache-missed; no OCR or shifted-year inference was used.
